mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_jmz_orders WHERE publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND manager_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT o.game_id AS gameId, g.name AS gameName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM tb_jmz_orders o LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_games g ON o.game_id = g.id
AND o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY o.game_id, g.name ORDER BY orderCount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(o.platform_fee) AS income FROM tb_jmz_orders o
AND o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
AND o.status = 5
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT o.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_jmz_orders o
AND o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY o.status
